response.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, COUNT(ili.invoice_number) as line_item_count, AVG(ili.product_price) as mean_product_price FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) SELECT AVG(mean_product_price) as avg_of_means, AVG(line_item_count) as avg_line_items FROM invoice_stats;
